Load functions
```{r}
library(dplyr)
source("R/functions.R")
```

```{r}
counts = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_DC_paper/input/Bulk_counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1)
coldata = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_DC_paper/input/Bulk_clinical_raw.csv", row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
table(coldata$R.NR)
```

Remove uncomplete cases 
```{r}
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::filter(R.NR %in% c("R", "NR"))

counts = counts[, rownames(coldata)]
```

DEG analysis
```{r}
res_deg = run_deg_analysis(counts, coldata, group_col = "R.NR", ref_level = "NR", pval = 5) 
res_t = res_deg %>%
  dplyr::select(t)
```

TF analysis
```{r}
tfs_deg = compute.TFs.activity(res_t,  TF.collection = "CollecTRI", min_targets_size = 5,
                               return = TRUE, file.name = "Test", universe = NULL) 

head(tfs_deg)
```

Plot TFs features
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
plot_top_TFs(tfs_deg, n_top = 10) +
  ggtitle('TF space')
```
